text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I can't stay like this forever! I have
to do
something, or else nothing will
ever change!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...But how do I begin?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, with a greeting, of course. "Hey
there, Trainer

<username>. Nice
job out—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes, like that. And next, I should—
choice_data_list: お疲れ様です、桐生院トレーナー

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?!
Trainer
<username>?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um... Well...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: A-actually... Well, I was just wondering...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
W-would you happen to have any
interest in
karaoke, perchance?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... In that case, would you care to join
me
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her suggestion is a bit sudden, but I
agree to go
to karaoke with Trainer
Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well... we're here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: N-not really...
choice_data_list: カラオケ、ご趣味なんですか？

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I can't even remember how
many years
it's been since the last time I
went.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It was probably... when I was still in
preschool,
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've entirely forgotten how this works.
Do we have
to call the staff to request
songs using this
phone?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see...
choice_data_list: いえ、そこのタブレットで……

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for inviting you out like this so
suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: A-actually...
choice_data_list: いったい何があったんですか……？

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Oh, there you are. Hey,
Meek—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What?! You don't hang out with your
trainer,
Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's wild. My trainer and I go to the
arcade
together all the time on my days
off!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My trainer likes playing video games.
She's sooo
good at them. She's even
helped me get better!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? That sounds fun...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm embarrassed to say this, but... I don't
have any
hobbies.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy reading trainer textbooks,
adjusting
training regimens, and
analyzing data. But those
things don't
count as hobbies...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So there's nothing I can do for fun with
Meek!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want her to always be bored
because
of that!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I remembered my mom taking me
when I
was very young.
choice_data_list: それで突然カラオケに……？

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That was the last time I went, but I
thought if I
started going more, I could
call it a hobby!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I never seem to do anything but study...
It's how I
spent my whole student life,
and even now, I...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I don't know why I'm like this...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... R-right, we should get started!
choice_data_list: と、とりあえず歌いましょう！

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: If it's okay with you, I'll go first!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle, little star! ♪ How I
wonder what
you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kiryuin may only know children's songs,
but her
voice is undeniably a thing of
beauty.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough... Oh my, I think I might be losing my voice from all that singing. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for accompanying me
today!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Really?! That's... I'm glad to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer
<username>...
If you
wouldn't mind...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Would you join me on my new "hobby"
again
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Only if it's not too much trouble, I mean!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
choice_data_list: ぜひまた行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin looks to be in high spirits
as we
talk on the way back home.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh... I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for springing such a weird question
on you
all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Uh... Please forget I asked.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Anyway... see you later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin takes her leave, looking
dejected.
